verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of retention or deletion controls such as TTL policies, retention settings, or documented DELETE/purge commands. The only related items are community remarks: one user keeps 60 days of data (their own arrangement), and another notes 'limited DELETE support'. Neither establishes a documented product capability for controlling retention and deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
